```{r}
#| label: setup
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
source(file.path(root, "scripts", "setup", "setup.R"))

if (!exists("SRS_UNITS", inherits = FALSE)) SRS_UNITS <- "mm"
SelectionTable <- .srsDeckSelections(
  params, root,
  path = if (exists("PathSRS", inherits = FALSE)) PathSRS else NULL
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_len(nrow(SelectionTable))) {
  PathSRS <- SelectionTable$PathSRS[[i]]
  ITS_FILE <- file.path(PathSRS, "data", "ITS.csv")
  if (!file.exists(ITS_FILE)) {
    stop(sprintf("SRS ITS input not found: %s", ITS_FILE), call. = FALSE)
  }
  ITSTable <- data.table::fread(ITS_FILE)
  META_FILE <- file.path(PathSRS, "metadata", "MasterIndex.csv")
  IMW_FILE <- file.path(PathSRS, "data", "IMW.csv")
  for (FILE in c(META_FILE, IMW_FILE)) {
    if (!file.exists(FILE)) stop(sprintf("SRS ITS caption input not found: %s", FILE), call. = FALSE)
  }
  MasterTable <- data.table::fread(META_FILE)
  IMWTable <- data.table::fread(IMW_FILE)
  MISS <- setdiff(c(
    "RecordID", "OCID", "EventName", "EventMagnitude", "EventMagnitudeType",
    "StationVs30", "Repi"
  ), names(MasterTable))
  if (length(MISS)) stop(sprintf("MasterIndex.csv missing columns: %s.", paste(MISS, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
  MISS <- setdiff(c("RecordID", "OCID", "PGA"), names(IMWTable))
  if (length(MISS)) stop(sprintf("IMW.csv missing columns: %s.", paste(MISS, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
  CaptionTable <- unique(MasterTable[OCID == "H1", .(
    RecordID, OCID, EventName, EventMagnitude, EventMagnitudeType, StationVs30, Repi
  )])
  CaptionTable <- merge(
    CaptionTable,
    IMWTable[OCID == "H1", .(RecordID, OCID, PGA = PGA)],
    by = c("RecordID", "OCID"),
    all.x = TRUE
  )
  CAPTION_DUP <- CaptionTable[, .N, by = .(RecordID, OCID)][N > 1L]
  if (nrow(CAPTION_DUP)) stop("SRS caption inputs have duplicate RecordID/OCID rows.", call. = FALSE)
  RecordOrder <- unique(ITSTable[OCID == "H1", .(RecordID)])
  RecordOrder <- merge(
    RecordOrder,
    IMWTable[OCID == "H1", .(RecordID, PGA = PGA)],
    by = "RecordID",
    all.x = TRUE
  )
  if (anyNA(RecordOrder$PGA)) stop("IMW.csv missing H1 PGA values for ITS records.", call. = FALSE)
  setorder(RecordOrder, -PGA, RecordID)
  RecordIDs <- head(as.character(RecordOrder$RecordID), 24L)
  if (!length(RecordIDs)) stop("SRS ITS has no RecordID values.", call. = FALSE)
  MISSING_CAPTIONS <- setdiff(RecordIDs, CaptionTable[OCID == "H1", RecordID])
  if (length(MISSING_CAPTIONS)) stop(sprintf(
    "SRS caption inputs missing H1 caption rows for: %s.",
    paste(MISSING_CAPTIONS, collapse = ", ")
  ), call. = FALSE)

  .srsMissing <- function(x) !length(x) || is.na(x) || !nzchar(as.character(x))
  .srsText <- function(x) if (.srsMissing(x)) "not available" else as.character(x)
  .srsNum <- function(x, digits) {
    if (.srsMissing(x)) return("not available")
    prettyNum(round(as.numeric(x), digits), big.mark = ",", nsmall = digits)
  }
  .srsMagnitude <- function(x) {
    M <- .srsNum(x$EventMagnitude, 2L)
    T <- .srsText(x$EventMagnitudeType)
    if (M == "not available" && T == "not available") return("magnitude not available")
    if (T == "not available") return(sprintf("M %s", M))
    if (M == "not available") return(T)
    sprintf("%s %s", T, M)
  }
  .srsPGA <- function(x) {
    if (.srsMissing(x)) return("not available")
    sprintf("%.3f g", as.numeric(x) / 9806.65)
  }
  .srsCaptionRow <- function(recordID) {
    X <- CaptionTable[RecordID == as.character(recordID) & OCID == "H1"]
    if (nrow(X) != 1L) stop(sprintf("SRS caption inputs have no single H1 row for %s.", recordID), call. = FALSE)
    X
  }
  .srsRecordText <- function(recordID) {
    X <- .srsCaptionRow(recordID)
    sprintf(
      "record %s (%s; %s; Repi = %s km; Vs30 = %s m/s; matched PGA = %s)",
      recordID,
      .srsText(X$EventName),
      .srsMagnitude(X),
      .srsNum(X$Repi, 1L),
      .srsNum(X$StationVs30, 0L),
      .srsPGA(X$PGA)
    )
  }
  .srsItsCaption <- function(recordID) sprintf(
    "Matched acceleration time history for %s. The solid line is the matched H1 component; dashed/dotted lines show retained VMD modal contributions.",
    .srsRecordText(recordID)
  )
  .knitSelectionBlock(
    path = "/_revealjs/srs.its.qmd",
    stem = "srs-its",
    selections = SelectionTable,
    i = i,
    vars = list(TITLE = sprintf(
        "Selected Ground-Motion Suite%s<br>Retained VMD Modal Time Histories",
        if (nrow(SelectionTable) > 1L) {
          sprintf(" — %s", SelectionTable$label[[i]])
        } else {
          ""
        }
      )),
    root = root,
    context = "SRS ITS deck"
  )
}
```

rm(list = intersect(c(
  "RecordIDs", "RecordID.target", "i", "PathSRS", "SelectionTable", "SRS_UNITS",
  "ITSTable", "ITS_FILE", "RecordOrder", "MasterTable", "IMWTable", "CaptionTable",
  "META_FILE", "IMW_FILE", "FILE", "CAPTION_DUP",
  "MISSING_CAPTIONS", "MISS", "PLOT",
  ".srsMissing", ".srsText", ".srsNum", ".srsMagnitude", ".srsPGA",
  ".srsCaptionRow", ".srsRecordText", ".srsItsCaption"
), ls()))
